# `lib/http.x`

Blocking HTTP/1.1 routing and worker-pool service.

| Function | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`Http.fail`](#Http.fail) | Raises an expected HTTP error before any response bytes are sent. |

| [`HttpRequest.json`](#HttpRequest.json) | Parses the request body as JSON. |

| [`HttpResponse.text`](#HttpResponse.text) | Replaces the body with UTF-8 text. |
| [`HttpResponse.write`](#HttpResponse.write) | Writes a complete response and flushes once. |
